titulo.modo_carreira_explicacao: Opponents always play one step above you. Any chess player can reach the end of the story.
titulo.modo_realista_explicacao: Every opponent plays at their real historical strength. Find out whether you could beat Tal.
abertura.continuar: click or press space to continue
quarto.dica: Look around the room. When you are ready, go out the door.
local.placar: Challenge: {pontos} point(s) in {jogadas} of {total} games · you need {minimo}
local.fim_do_dia: The day is over. See the result
partida.sua_vez_xeque: Your move — you are in check!
partida.abandonar_pergunta: Resign the game? It counts as a loss.
partida.fim_afogamento: Stalemate: the king has no move and is not in check.
partida.fim_repeticao: The same position occurred three times.
partida.fim_material: Neither side has enough material to mate.
partida.fim_50_lances: Fifty moves without a capture or a pawn move.
resultado.forca: Estimated strength: {forca} (nobody had a rating in 1950; this is the game's yardstick)
local.placar_torneio: Round {rodada} of {total}: you vs {adversario} · you have {pontos}
partida.fim_tempo_seu: Your flag fell: you ran out of time.
partida.fim_tempo_dele: Your opponent's flag fell: their time ran out.
partida.fim_tempo_sem_material: The flag fell, but the other side had only the king: there was no way to mate.
capitulos.aviso: Starting another chapter ends the games of the chapter in progress. Your strength and completed chapters are kept.
apelido.explicacao: With a nickname, the game keeps your progress and your games on the server, and the game's author can see the history of who plays. We don't ask for an email or a password.
apelido.falhou: Couldn't reach the server right now. Try again, or play without saving your history (your progress is still saved on this device).
capitulos.trancado: 🔒 Locked: win the previous chapter first
adiamento.selar_sua_vez: The session is over. Your next move doesn't go on the board: it goes on a slip of paper, into the envelope. Think it over and play it.
adiamento.selar_dele: The session is over. {nome} writes down the sealed move…
adiamento.envelope_seu:
You write {lance} on a slip of paper, fold it and hand it to the arbiter. He puts it in the envelope and seals it, and you both sign across the flap.

Tomorrow morning the envelope is opened right here, and each of you gets one more hour on the clock.
adiamento.envelope_dele:
{nome} writes the move on a slip of paper, folds it and hands it to the arbiter without letting you see. The envelope is sealed, and you both sign across the flap.

Tomorrow morning the envelope is opened right here. Until then, you'll have to guess the move.
adiamento.noite_seu:
The position is set up on your grandfather's board, with your sealed move already played, {lance}. Now it's {nome}'s turn.

Move the pieces of both sides as you like. Nobody forbids analysing at home; at the club, everyone does it. When you're ready, get some sleep.
adiamento.noite_dele:
The position is set up on your grandfather's board, just as it was left at the club. The sealed move is {nome}'s, and you don't know what it is.

Move the pieces of both sides as you like and look for what he might have written. Nobody forbids analysing at home; at the club, everyone does it.
adiamento.voltar_ao_clube: Sleep, then back to the club
adiamento.abrindo_envelope: The arbiter checks the signatures and opens the envelope…
adiamento.lance_do_envelope: In the envelope: {lance}. The clock is running again.
